destination.name: Blue Mountains
destination.tagline: World Heritage sandstone cliffs, waterfalls and the Three Sisters, a train ride west of Sydney.
destination.description: Katoomba, the main base for this national park, is 103 km west of Sydney, and the park is a plateau of sandstone cliffs and forested valleys, part of the Greater Blue Mountains Area that UNESCO inscribed in 2000. The Three Sisters at Echo Point are the best-known sight, and the nearby towns of Leura, Wentworth Falls, Blackheath and Mount Victoria give access to waterfalls, the Grose Valley lookouts and over 140 km of walking tracks. Visitors arrive by road or by train from Sydney Central, which takes about two hours.
whyVisit: See the Three Sisters from Echo Point
Ride Scenic World into the Jamison Valley
Walk to waterfalls beneath the cliffs

goodToKnow.title: Check track closures
goodToKnow.detail: Tracks close often and some for long periods, including part of National Pass after a landslide and the Govetts descent at Blackheath; check the NPWS alerts page before you set out.

goodToKnow.title: Trains and buses
goodToKnow.detail: Trains from Sydney Central run to Katoomba and Leura without reservations and take about two hours; local bus 686 links Katoomba station, Echo Point and Scenic World, but Wentworth Falls and Leura Cascades need a bus, taxi or car.

goodToKnow.title: Dress for fog, set your GPS
goodToKnow.detail: The mountains can be up to 10 C colder than the coast and fog can hide the views all day in cold, wet weather; set your GPS to 'Echo Point, Katoomba', since 'Blue Mountains' routes to unsealed roads.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Come in {months}, when the days are cool enough for the cliff walks and the autumn colour is out at Mount Wilson and Blackheath.

blue-mountains-4.bio: A cliff-top lookout at Blackheath with sweeping views of the Grose Valley wilderness.

blue-mountains-3.bio: Waterfalls and clifftop lookouts above the valley at Wentworth Falls, the start of the Grand Cliff Top Walk to Leura and Katoomba.

blue-mountains-6.bio: Waterfalls on the Leura Cascades and Fern Bower circuit near Leura; part of the circuit is closed for repairs, so check the NPWS alerts.

blue-mountains-2.bio: A Katoomba cliff-and-valley attraction with the Scenic Railway, Skyway, Cableway and rainforest Walkway.

blue-mountains-11.bio: A 6.3 km loop from the Grand Canyon car park near Blackheath that descends through rainforest along Greaves Creek and climbs out at Evans Lookout.

blue-mountains-12.bio: A Grose Valley lookout above Blackheath, where the Grand Canyon walk climbs out.
